title: Sughra Nu Udeekan Nay Akbar
body:
Sughra nu udeekaan nay Akbar Bhira diyaan
Koi Khabraan nayee aaiyaan karbal chon hamshakal e Payambar bhira diyaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Chad Pardes veerun puch bhen bhain da haal
Nalay aa kay das maino khabraan koi meray chotay Asghar bhira diyaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tenu Bhuliyaa Akbar saray kehnday mennu
mai khwan beshak bhul jaaye veer mennu par mai tay nokar bhira diyaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadon da Akbar nay pardes wasaya
Uss din rondi rehndi beemar chaitay haye gallaan kar kar bhira diyaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaa ke paighaam joi devay Akbar nu
Mar jaavay na Sughra tak tak raahon karbal day musafir bhira diyaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Phuppi Zainab jay meray kol howay
Mangaa Akbar ooday kolon day de qamaan ohday sohnay saabir bhira diyaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tasbeeh Akbar day naa dee mai karaan
Wird mera aeho banyaan din raat fida mai Sughra zakir bhira diyaan
